breeding.method: Purple #1 male × early Skunk female; offered as regular and feminised seed

lineage.note: Dutch Passion's current history page specifies a Purple #1 male crossed with an exceptional early Skunk female and identifies the result as a sativa-dominant F1 hybrid.

aromas.note: Official product description calls the aroma fresh, sweet and spicy; more specifically sweet, fruity, floral and spicy, with sour/pine and sometimes woody notes across phenotypes.

terpenes.note: Dutch Passion uses sensory 'terpene profile' descriptors such as spicy/herbal and aroma terms, but the reviewed official sources do not identify a compound-level terpene composition. No compounds are inferred.

origin.text: The Netherlands; Dutch Passion outdoor breeding program
origin.note: Official history states Shaman originated in Dutch Passion's outdoor breeding program and was selected over years under Dutch outdoor conditions.

history.text: Developed through years of outdoor selection in the Netherlands from Purple #1 × early Skunk.
history.note: Dutch Passion describes decades of Dutch outdoor/greenhouse selection for the cultivar.
